task_title: Implement RISK_REWARD_FUSED danger/reward pathing (opt-in, default-OFF) + retune + viz + A/B harness

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (gpt-5.4) review of the fused-pathing plan. 3 concerns, all resolved: (1) BLOCKING - fused determinism was unproven, and the whole shipping claim rests on the fused path being deterministic AND non-inert; resolved by adding tests/headless/fused-pathing-determinism.test.ts (byte-identical across two runs for seeds 42/101 + a divergence check proving fused != legacy), which runs in the test:headless suite (3/3 green). (2) Continuity-lifecycle: computeRiskRewardFusedHeading did not clear prevFusedDir on the no-target (baseLen<=eps) early return, so a stale heading could bias the next travel poll via the W_CONTINUITY term - fixed in commit fb70592d. (3) Brittle unit assertion (chosen candidate angle >= 30 deg) - softened to guaranteed invariants (angleDeg !== 0 AND chosen.danger < straight.danger). Accepted known limitation documented in the handoff: fused is a melee-favoring WASH on the new welcome-room Floor-1 (A/B sweep tied 32/36 vs 32/36 with 2 win->loss flips); it ships opt-in/default-OFF as documented experimental, the A/B win-rate gate is RETAINED as a truthful guard (never weakened - rules #12/#13), and navmesh is the real pathing path (Slice 3).

rounds.notes: claude-sonnet-4.6 full review of the fused diff vs origin/main. All four hard contracts VERIFIED (LEGACY byte-identity, determinism, NaN/zero-vector safety, A/B harness win/flip gate). 2 NON-BLOCKING issues found, both fixed in commit 7317b828: (#1) the blendedLen<=eps early return in computeRiskRewardFusedHeading did not clear prevFusedDir like the baseLen return above it (continuity consistency); (#2) ROOT CAUSE of the observed bow regression - FUSED mode skipped the additive Track B blend entirely, so when the scorer yields {0,0} (no travel target, e.g. a ranged AI between shots) the player froze for the frame instead of sidestepping the way LEGACY does. Fixed by passing dodge/pull through when the fused scorer yields {0,0}, gated on a fusedYieldedZero flag that can only be true in fused mode so LEGACY stays byte-identical.

claude-sonnet-4.6 re-review of the fix diff (fb70592d..7317b828). All four hard contracts re-verified with file:line evidence: (1) byte-identity - fusedYieldedZero is declared false and written only inside if(useFused); in LEGACY the final guard `!useFused || fusedYieldedZero` short-circuits on `true` before reading the flag, identical to the old `if(!useFused)`; (2) no double-count - the fused scorer returns {0,0} only on the baseLen<=eps path (folds nothing in), and its two non-zero returns are always unit vectors, so fusedYieldedZero cannot false-trigger and the passthrough blend is the first/only dodge application; (3) dodge availability - travel-steering's dodge/pull zeroing is gated on objMag>eps which is 0 in the fused-zero case, so the tree-tick dodge/pull vectors survive for blendWithTrackB (which is side-effect-free); (4) determinism - no Math.random/Date.now/performance.now, fusedYieldedZero is a pure boolean of deterministic inputs. Validated green: verify:fast (93 unit), fused determinism headless (3/3, byte-identical seeds 42/101), collision-pair-parity (5/5 = LEGACY byte-identity on the new code). LOOP CLOSED - no BLOCKING or NON-BLOCKING concerns.
